originalCatalogRecord.name: Druidcraft

operational.targets: One Small-or-smaller ordinary natural plant, patch of harmless vegetation, or similarly minor natural feature within range
operational.duration: Instantaneous; the harmless natural change then persists normally until ordinary conditions alter it
operational.effect: Cause one minor non-damaging natural effect comparable in scale to making flowers bloom, leaves open or close, grass briefly bend, seeds sprout visibly without maturing, or a small patch of ordinary vegetation change harmlessly in appearance.
operational.limitations: Cannot deal damage, restrain creatures, create difficult terrain, produce food or potable water, accelerate a crop to harvest, create valuable herbs, rare reagents, timber, poison, medicine, commodities, permanent supernatural plants, or free crafting materials. It does not replace a survival, farming, or crafting procedure. Cantrip repeats use Refrain.
operational.designNotes: Core V2 Action, 30-foot range, Instantaneous duration, and V/S components are retained. The source only specifies minor natural effects such as blooming flowers; the operational scale and anti-commodity limits are NEW provisional boundaries.

originalCatalogRecord.name: Mending

operational.targets: One nonliving mundane object within range containing one accessible break, tear, split seam, cracked joint, or separated mundane connection no larger than 1 foot across
operational.resolution: None if the damage is within the listed repair scope.
operational.effect: Repair one minor physical break or tear, rejoining the affected mundane material enough for ordinary noncombat function if all required pieces are present.
operational.limitations: Does not restore device or construct HP, charges, ammunition, spell uses, limited resources, duration, destroyed mechanisms, magical properties, consumed materials, missing pieces, valuable raw materials, structural buildings, armor/weapon combat durability beyond the cosmetic or mundane joint repaired, or an object reduced to total destruction. It cannot manufacture a new object or repeatedly create saleable material. Cantrip repeats use Refrain.
operational.designNotes: Core V2 Action, 30-foot range, Instantaneous duration, and V/S components are retained. The 1-foot minor-repair scope and explicit distinction from device HP/resources are NEW provisional bounded-repair rules required for integration.

originalCatalogRecord.name: Shape Water

operational.name: Shape Water
operational.targets: One contiguous quantity of nonmagical liquid water fitting a 5-foot cube within range; unattended, caster-held or willingly presented/contained. No hostile worn/carried container.
operational.duration: Instantaneous; ordinary gravity resumes after resolution.
operational.effect: Move the actual water up to 5 feet along an unobstructed path into available space, or reshape its surface harmlessly. Cannot create, freeze, purify, split an occupied body, lift a creature, deal damage, grant a swimming speed or maintain an unsupported shape. Actual potable water remains potable; no abstract Supply is created.
operational.limitations: No automatic level scaling, generic upcast or new action budget. Use the actual casting source's access, components, costs, shared concentration and Dissonance/Refrain, then the legal interruption window. Countering or later failure refunds no committed use/payment or displaced concentration. Spell attacks use d20 + PB + actual source casting modifier; saves use DC 8 + PB + that modifier. Actual defenses, critical rules, core conditions, ordinary life-state rules and source-specific callbacks retain their scopes. Total cover prevents targeting unless this card expressly allows otherwise. For ancestry casts use ANCESTRY_BACKGROUND_PLAYTEST.md; existing ordinary identities retain their actual class/school/rank access and RP price.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED existing catalog/Core identity, source placement, action, range and components. Explicit operational additions are conference decisions.

originalCatalogRecord.name: Resonance Shield

operational.targets: One willing creature you can perceive within 30 feet
operational.duration: Until the temporary HP are lost or you complete a long rest
operational.effect: In addition to the class-specific rank cost and any Dissonance surcharge, spend 1 RP. Roll 1d4; the chosen creature gains that many temporary HP. It keeps the higher of these or its existing temporary HP; they never add together.
operational.scaling: None. Damage dice, target count, range and duration do not automatically increase with character or class level.
operational.limitations: The additional 1 RP conversion cost is mandatory. Temporary HP never restore real HP and cannot generate resources when gained or lost. Recasting requires a new paid cast and roll; keep the higher remaining amount. Rank is class-specific, so this spell is not necessarily a cantrip for every class. If the Core source placement matching the class-specific school and rank includes F, an existing class casting focus is additionally required.
operational.designNotes: Conference decision: use the rank-0 1d4 effect plus mandatory1RP as the provisional single-ID rule. Retain all variants: rank0 catalog/Core1d4; rank2 catalog5tempHP perRP; rank2 Core2tempHP perRP. Rank2 alternatives are preserved as evidence, not cumulative effects or optional upgrades. Use Core30ft range and placement-specific focus requirement. Temporary HP end on next long rest; no fixed5 buff.
operational.previousDraftDesignNotes: NEW provisional reconciliation of conflicting source placements. The source contains both 'convert 1 RP into 1d4 temporary HP' and '5 temporary HP per RP spent.' This unified playtest record uses the explicit +1 RP interface requested for the tranche and the fixed 5-HP value from the stronger detailed summary; the 1d4 variant remains preserved in the source ledger.
